facts: 1857 design, 1859–1866 construction; Eduard Knoblauch and Friedrich August Stüler

Current rear glazed wall overlooks the traced former hall, not a rebuilt historical auditorium
Present preserved building and Centrum Judaicum history
Do not reconstruct the destroyed rear prayer hall
